meta.audience: people who want music that fits the mood they are in, and a diary of those moods
meta.title: MOOD FM
meta.reviewed: Written by hand from the app: source/README.md, its design tokens (src/app.css in the app repository), its colour and mood code (domain/color.ts, domain/mood.ts: eight stations, OKLCH palettes mixed by inverse distance), its track names (domain/music.ts) and its captured archive. The stage colour in every frame is computed by the app's own paletteAt for the mood on screen; coral #F08464 is the on-air lamp.

source.notes: a small radio tuned to your mood: a 2-axis mood pad and an FM dial with eight stations; colour and generative music follow the mood; moods are kept as a colour diary
the real app's archive (its production build, served locally) captured by capture/app.json: September 2026 with each day painted in that day's mood, and the year in pixels
Pretendard Variable (the app's face) and JetBrains Mono (labels); SIL OFL 1.1

rationale.palette: No fixed palette: the background is the app's stage gradient (radial m3 at 82% 18%, radial m1 at 12% 92%, linear 135deg m1 to m2 to m3) for the mood on screen, computed by the app's own paletteAt over its eight stations and four corner anchors in OKLab; text takes the app's ink (#0B0B0C or #F6F2EE) for contrast; coral #F08464 is the on-air lamp and the dial's needle.
rationale.type: Pretendard Variable at 900 with -0.065em for the frequency (the app's 93.1), 800 for headlines and station names; JetBrains Mono capitals for the ticker and labels (MHz, STATION 03 OF 08).
rationale.motion: A radio being tuned: the coral needle sweeps the FM scale and settles on stations, the frequency rolls, the whole frame's colour glides with it; the mood pad's puck is dragged and the colour follows; the diary's days light up one by one.
rationale.sound: Lo-fi in F major at 96 BPM (6 bars in 15 s, 12 in 30 s): warm keys and dusty drums, a late-night radio under a mood dial, soft organic SFX for the needle and the lamp.
rationale.visuals: Four scenes in the 15 s cut: the name and the app's line on the stage as the lamp goes on air; the dial swept from 비 to 들뜸 with the colour following; September's diary lighting up in its moods; the end card. The 30 s cut adds the mood pad.
rationale.narration: Not recommended: a short, muted launch reel with slogan-length Korean copy shown as type.
